design.alternative_shell: 1 <= D_KL(Q||P) <= 1.25 for Gaussian Q=N(mu,r), mu>=0; negative mu by global sign symmetry

transport.anchor_radius: rho_a=min_x kl(0.09||U_CP(a,x))/(64-x), with U_CP the direct JOINT adjacent-pair failure Clopper-Pearson upper bound
transport.cell_cover: Tile the positive-mean (mu,r) bounding rectangle. Reject cells provably outside the KL shell using exact min/max of I(mu,r)=0.5[mu^2+r-1-log r]. Because target-to-anchor Gaussian KL is convex in (mu,r), its maximum on a rectangle is at a corner; certify a cell when one anchor rho exceeds all four corner KL values.

continuum_shell_cover.result: Conditional on the simultaneous Clopper-Pearson anchor bounds and ordinary float64 coverage arithmetic, every Gaussian Q in the full two-dimensional shell 1<=D_KL(Q||P)<=1.25 has direct adjacent-pair failure probability <=0.09 for every discrete changepoint offset x=0..16.

resource_signal.observation: Per-level anchor count does not decrease outward despite smaller observed joint-failure probabilities: 75,77,78,82,82,88 anchors for KL levels 1.125..1.25.
resource_signal.interpretation: The Gaussian KL level set grows geometrically enough that brute finite-shell covering may become more expensive even as each anchor gets a larger transport radius. This is evidence to prioritize an analytic high-information tail handoff rather than extending shells indefinitely.

scope_limits: Covers only Gaussian alternatives through KL 1.25, not all KL>=1.
Coverage and CP quantile arithmetic remain ordinary floating point, not directed-rounding or interval verified.
Randomized confidence concerns the offline Monte Carlo certification procedure; this is not a closed-form power theorem.
exact_next_action: Stop blindly extending dense radial shells. Derive or locate an analytic high-information lower-tail bound for the exact conditional-SNML adjacent-candidate statistic under Gaussian subgroup contamination, strong enough to hand off above some KL radius. In parallel replay the r76 1..1.25 cell inequalities with conservative high-precision/directed-rounding arithmetic. If no analytic handoff closes, test only sparse outer shells to locate the smallest safe handoff radius instead of certifying every radial level.
